intro: Over the past five months, ZCyberNews has tracked 62 social-engineering incidents, with ClickFix, Lazarus Group, and UNC6692 among the most frequently observed actors. Coverage frequently cited CVE-2023-36036, CVE-2025-24054, CVE-2025-33053, and CVE-2026-21513. The financial services, cryptocurrency, technology, and government sectors were most affected, with reports spanning North America, Europe, the United States, and Australia. The severity mix included 48 high, 11 medium, 2 informational, and 1 critical findings, reflecting a sustained operational focus on human-centric compromise techniques.
